title: Countdown Day 90
excerpt: 90. Some see the Christian faith … [as] an old woman past her prime, closer to a nursing home than to nursing new life. But I see it differently. (ix) From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith (available February 9, 2010)
body:
90. Some see the Christian faith … [as] an old woman past her prime, closer to a nursing home than to nursing new life. But I see it differently. (ix)

 From A New Kind of Christianity: Ten Questions That Are Transforming the Faith (available February 9, 2010)
